appContext.summary: GPS yardages, live scoring, side games

theme.style: Clubhouse at dusk: deep forest green velvet and felt tones lit by warm ivory and burnished brass light, like late-afternoon sun slanting through tall clubhouse windows. The deck uses fine film grain, soft directional golden-hour glow, polished metallic sheens and leather-rich warmth. Backgrounds stay calm, dark and luxurious, with the upper third quiet for headlines. The mood is traditional and quietly confident, never flashy.
